8.en: The shadow wars fought by acolytes of the Holy Orders are often long and arduous, their conditions unforgiving and their stakes high. Yet it does not end there. Even between their missions, they must hone their skills and expand their contact networks, lest the next assignment fails and a world — or even the Macharian Sector — is lost. It is a grim saying repeated in the Imperium that duty only ends in death, and those who serve the Inquisition are all too aware of every aspect of that truth.
